run_go_io_evaluator_check_outputs: run Go code against input/output test cases using GoInputOutputEvaluator.check_outputs and assert success or failure
test_go_program_compilation_with_imports: test a Go program compiles and runs correctly by instantiating GoInputOutputEvaluator with run_go_imports enabled
test_go_program_compilation_without_impo: test a Go program fails compilation by instantiating GoInputOutputEvaluator with run_go_imports set to False
test_go_compilation_timeout: test Go compilation timeout behavior by setting compilation_timeout on GoInputOutputEvaluator and checking for timeout results
test_go_firejail_sandbox: test that Go code runs in a firejail sandbox that prevents file writes using GoInputOutputEvaluator with a timeout
